verdict.rationale: The pack shows no documented way for a user to operate Featurebase itself through natural-language commands. The Fibi AI agent and instant AI search answers serve end customers, AI decluttering of feedback is a related but different feature, and API endpoints described as 'ideal for AI agents' plus llms.txt are developer building blocks, not a natural-language control interface. None of these earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
